verdict.rationale: Capacities is a note-taking/knowledge platform, so an official MCP server is a fair axis. Its developer docs say agents integrate with a space by implementing an MCP client, Chat Connectors link ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor and Le Chat to a space, and a probe found the official MCP server documented. Missing for 10: details on the server's endpoint, auth and exposed tools, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Build your own app, agent, or bot and integrate it with a Capacities space by implementing a custom MCP client using the Model Context Protocol (MCP) open standard.
Chat Connectors let you connect AI chat apps, like ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, or Le Chat, to your Capacities space.
